subject: System Design
title: The Facebook Outage of 2021
description: A 60-second lesson on The Facebook Outage of 2021.

hook.text: On October 4, 2021, Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp vanished from the internet for six hours.

buildup.text: A routine BGP configuration change accidentally withdrew all routes to Facebook's servers.

discovery.text: Without BGP routes, DNS couldn't resolve facebook.com. The entire platform became unreachable worldwide.

twist.text: Engineers couldn't fix it remotely — their own tools ran on Facebook's network. They drove to data centers.

climax.text: One misconfigured command took down services used by 3.5 billion people. Cost: over $6 billion in revenue.

punchline.text: A single config change deleted Facebook from the internet.

quiz.question: What caused the 2021 Facebook outage?
options: A BGP configuration change that withdrew all routes
